'''Falks Reach''' was the name given to the sandbar connecting [[Mannett Point]] to the larger island of [[Avilatan]] on [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]]. The two islands were also linked by a bridge that spanned the sandbar, but it was destroyed in the [[Separatist War]].
